title: Fasten a spring-loaded access plate while maintaining its preload
instruction: Press the grey access plate level against its marked height while turning the eight orange nuts down their studs. Keep the plate controlled as the nuts capture its spring load. Seat every nut against the plate, then withdraw both hands; the plate must remain level and compressed.
context: A sustained rotational-assembly prototype with measurable thread advance on a movable fixture.
limitations: The access plate uses one vertical spring and two passive tilt joints as a reduced model of a guided spring-loaded cover; it can rise and tip before the nuts retain it.
Enlarged 4 mm-pitch square-profile threads use 16 rigid contact sectors per turn with real collision contact. No helical attachment or proximity snapping is used.
The task measures pitch-coupled advancement, seating and retained plate compression. It does not certify bolt tension, friction torque or sealing performance.
Native contact forces, spring-load transfer, two expert episodes and model evaluation remain unexecuted.
